kashika: षष्ठीनिर्दिष्टस्य य उच्यत आदेशः, सोऽन्त्यस्यालः स्थाने वेदितव्यः। <<इद् गोण्याः>> [[१.२.५०]] — पञ्चगोणिः। दशगोणिः॥
kashikaEnglish: A substitute prescribed in the genitive replaces only the last sound of the original.
englishShort: आदेश told in a sutra happens in the place of the last letter of the स्थानी.
englishFull:
A substitute replaces only the final letter of the genitive-case term.

**Example:** @ref[7.2.102] says त्यदादीनामः — "अ in place of त्यद् etc."

This doesn't replace all of त्यद्, only its final द्:
त्यद् → त्य + अ = त्य

Similarly @ref[1.2.50] इद्गोण्याः — short इ replaces only the final of गोणी:
पञ्चगोणिः "purchased for five goṇīs"
